in_sanskrit.name: Shaveta
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shaveta एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shaveta is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shri’ which means wealth or prosperity. The name is also believed to be derived from the Goddess of Fortune, Lakshmi. The name signifies the blessing of the Goddess on the child, bestowing her with prosperity, wealth, and good fortune.
